title: ItzTags
body:
**️ItzTags** is a lightweight and easy-to-use Minecraft plugin that allows server administrators to create custom player tags and assign them to any player. Whether you want to showcase ranks, achievements, roles, or special statuses, ItzTags provides a flexible way to personalize player identities and make them stand out on your server.

Designed with simplicity and performance in mind, ItzTags makes managing custom tags quick and straightforward while giving players a more unique and engaging experience.

Here is all the info you need to use this plugin.
Commands:
- **/tags** - opens menu with all your avaible tags for use
- **/tag create <name> <prefix>** - creates tag with custom prefix that supports colors and gradients
- **/tag remove <name>** - completely removes the tag from everyone
- **/tag give <player> <name>** - gives player access to this tag which will be avaible in /tags
- **/tag take <player> <name>** - removes the tag from player
- **/tag reload** - reloads all changes made from config
- **/tag list** - lists all tags on the server
- **/tag edit <name> <new prefix>** - edits the prefix of the tag

Permissions:
- **itztags.give** - grants access to /tag give and /tag take (great for lower staff members)
- **itztags.admin** - grants full access to all commands

Placeholders:
- **%itztags_tag%** - placeholder that shows players current equipped tag

Features:
- **RGB Gradients** - supports custom colors with gradients
- Menu with all your owned tags
- Very simple to use and everything can be done in game using commands but you can also use config
- Give each player up to 28 custom tags

Requires:
- PlaceholderAPI

If you want to suggest new ideas, need support or report a bug make sure to join my discord: https://discord.gg/XrBDFYR2aa
